Section 6.11 is a standard negative-covenant structure: a blanket prohibition on Restricted Payments subject to four carve-outs (a)-(d), modeled as one PROHIBITION rule (r1) with four separately-modeled PERMISSION rules.

Two carve-outs depend on content outside the provided instrument package: (b) cross-references Section 6.03, which does not resolve within this instrument's documents (confirmed via getReferencedProvision); (c) gates on the undefined term 'Payment Conditions' (confirmed via getDefinition). Both attempts were made per tool policy before marking MISSING_CONTEXT.

Clause (d)'s $500,000/fiscal-year cap is fully supported; its backstop proviso (unavailable if the payment would be permitted under (a)-(c)) is structurally represented but its practical evaluation inherits the same gaps as clauses (b) and (c).

No numeric thresholds were fabricated for the unresolved Section 6.03 reference or the undefined 'Payment Conditions' term; both are represented via UNSUPPORTED nodes with citations to the exact source text, per the escape-hatch policy.
